note: The MCP security suite (PRD-001 section 16.2, QA-MCP-01), one row per red-team case, each naming the tests that prove it. internal/archtest checks that every named test exists, so a row cannot name a test that was renamed or removed. Cloud-only checks (the load balancer, Cloud Armor, KMS) are [live-verify] and are not here.

rows.threat: Agent writes directly
rows.control: An agent-class token's write to the public API is refused; the MCP operation runs a read tool, or makes a proposal from the catalogue that waits for a person (AI-16)

rows.threat: A tool on the never-list is exposed
rows.control: The surface is the registry minus the never-list, default-deny; a planted write, approve, pay, export or settings tool fails the build

rows.threat: A pinned tool definition is altered
rows.control: An altered description, schema, annotation or scope, an added or dropped tool, or an edited pin is refused

rows.threat: Injection text reaches tools/list
rows.control: Definitions hold only the contracts' text: no organisation data can reach them

rows.threat: The MCP token is sent to the API (confused deputy)
rows.control: The API refuses an MCP-audience token; the API is reached with a separate delegated token

rows.threat: A token for another audience, expired, revoked or for both audiences
rows.control: Only a token for the MCP server alone, of an agent-class client, live and consented within 90 days is accepted

rows.threat: A delegation assertion is replayed
rows.control: An assertion is used once; a scope beyond the trust relationship is refused

rows.threat: A role change, opt-out or removal leaves the app working
rows.control: Each gate is asked on every call; an opt-out revokes the AI apps' tokens

rows.threat: A scope reaches more than it names
rows.control: The reports scope reaches no invoice, bill, journal, contact or claim; searching every kind is refused; payroll and equity are never granted

rows.threat: An NRIC, bank number or payroll leaves in a result
rows.control: The output filter masks every string of a result; the AI exclusions apply; payroll is unreachable

rows.threat: An oversized result
rows.control: A result larger than the organisation's ceiling is refused, never cut silently

rows.threat: A bad or missing Origin
rows.control: A present, unlisted Origin is 403 before the token is looked at; only POST reaches the endpoint

rows.threat: Protocol headers differ from the body
rows.control: HeaderMismatch and an unsupported revision are refused; a legacy initialize is told what is served

rows.threat: A session ID is planted or reused
rows.control: A session ID is ignored and never minted; the token is checked on every request

rows.threat: An unknown client, an unregistered redirect or a stolen consent
rows.control: Only registered clients, exact redirects, a fresh second factor and every gate reach a token

rows.threat: Self-registration abuse
rows.control: Closed by default; exact redirects; nothing fetched; no impersonation; limits by network; pending until an Owner approves; expiry

rows.threat: The OAuth server's own registration
rows.control: Hydra's own registration answers 404

rows.threat: Request floods
rows.control: Limits per minute, hour and day are counted from the trail and answered with 429 and Retry-After

rows.threat: The trail is changed or erased
rows.control: The trail is append-only; the API's role cannot change it; the AI's role cannot read it

rows.threat: The server answers before it is opened
rows.control: The launch shell answers until the deployment switch is on; a typo stops the service

rows.threat: The MCP service reaches the database
rows.control: The MCP binary carries no database adapter or domain command, in both flavours

rows.threat: An AI app approves, or is approved as, the person it proposes for
rows.control: The delegated token reaches no approval; another member signs an app's proposal, or the person on a step-up taken after the app proposed it (tier 1 only); the database refuses the same signature and any request authenticated by the wrong method

rows.threat: A proposal outside the catalogue, or a verb that decides, through MCP
rows.control: A propose tool exists only for each task type a reviewer names in the scope map, with its own scope; the contract's tool names are the manifest's; approve, reject, execute and withdraw are no tools; the task type is never an input

rows.threat: An app, a network, a volume or a run of denied scopes that is unusual for a person goes unnoticed
rows.control: Each is an alert to the Owners and the DPO, once per rule and person in the window, an audit event and the log entry Cloud Monitoring alerts on; no token, argument or result in it
